intro.text: A Shin monastery on a hill near the Misted Mountains, surrounded by a town and pine trees.

description.text: Its stone walls and narrow windows serve a defensive purpose. Gemstones light the interior, and a pond nearby freezes over.

items.text: Szeth trained here during his pilgrimage to become an Honorbearer, practicing Division and Abrasion. He used the frozen pond to practice moving with little friction.
On returning to the monastery, Szeth faced its Honorbearer without striking back. Their confrontation ended without a killing, and his party continued to the Skybreaker monastery.
